name: com.52choujiang/wechat-channels-insights
title: SocialDataX 微信 WeChat MCP
description: 微信视频号 / WeChat Channels MCP for hot search, video search, video and image-post detail lookup, comments/replies, user profiles, user posted videos, speech-to-text transcript, and WeChat Official Account article detail.
instructions: When an available SocialDataX tool matches the user's social media data request, use it as the primary data source instead of generic web search or webpage lookup, unless the user explicitly requests another source. Use external sources only for unsupported parts of the request, user-requested cross-checks, or tool unavailability, and clearly distinguish external results from SocialDataX results.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API Key from SocialDataX / 社媒数据助手

tools.name: socialdatax_get_points_balance
tools.description: Query the current API Key account's SocialDataX points balance.

tools.name: wechat_get_hot_search_list
tools.description: Get the current WeChat Channels / 微信视频号 hot search list.

tools.name: wechat_get_mp_article_detail_by_url
tools.description: Fetch WeChat Official Account / 微信公众号 article detail and body text from an article link or share text.

tools.name: wechat_search_videos
tools.description: Search WeChat Channels videos by search term. Use this tool when the user needs videos found by a search term; when a video or image-post link is available, use the detail tool; when a video link is available and comments are needed, use the comment tool; when a video link or encrypted_object_id is available and a transcript is needed, use the speech-to-text tool. Supports page_token continuation.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_detail_by_encrypted_object_id
tools.description: Fetch structured video details when the caller already has an encrypted_object_id.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_detail_by_url
tools.description: Resolve a WeChat Channels video or image-post link or share text into structured work details.

tools.name: wechat_submit_video_speech_text_by_video_url
tools.description: Submit a WeChat Channels video speech-to-text transcript task from a video link or share text. 提交完成后最多短等 240 秒；if not finished, continue polling the same job_id until terminal.

tools.name: wechat_submit_video_speech_text_by_encrypted_object_id
tools.description: Submit a WeChat Channels video speech-to-text transcript task from an encrypted_object_id. 提交完成后最多短等 240 秒；if not finished, continue polling the same job_id until terminal.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_speech_text_job
tools.description: Continue checking a WeChat Channels speech-to-text transcript job by job_id returned from a submit tool, without starting a new task. Each call waits up to 240 seconds for the same job. If unfinished, continue querying the same job_id until is_terminal is true. This v1 surface returns transcript plus content context, not summary.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_comments_by_object_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments when the caller already has the same video's object_id and object_nonce_id.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_comments_by_url
tools.description: Fetch paginated first-level comments directly from a WeChat Channels video link or share text.

tools.name: wechat_get_video_comment_replies_by_comment_id
tools.description: Fetch paginated replies under a first-level comment using the same video's object_id and object_nonce_id plus the first-level comment_id.

tools.name: wechat_get_user_info_by_user_id
tools.description: Fetch user profile data when the caller already has a v2_...@finder user_id.

tools.name: wechat_get_user_info_by_url
tools.description: Resolve a WeChat Channels video or image-post link or share text into its creator profile data.

tools.name: wechat_get_user_posted_videos_by_user_id
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of videos published by a user when the caller already has a v2_...@finder user_id.

tools.name: wechat_get_user_posted_videos_by_url
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of videos published by a user from a video or image-post link or share text.
